quote: "لەم دنیا کاتییەدا تۆ هەموو شتێکی منی."
letterBody: From the moment I met you, something in me knew. You walked in and suddenly everything felt right.
Every day with you is a gift I don't take for granted.
Thank you for choosing me. For your patience, your kindness, your warmth.
I love you more than any words on this page could ever say.
finalText: هەموو ڕۆژێک لەگەڵ تۆیا دیاری خوایە.
surprise: You are my favorite person, my safest place, my greatest adventure. I love you. ❤️

moments.title: aw katai yakman nasi
moments.text: هێشتا بیرمە چەند نازت ئەکرد بەسەرما ئەوکاتە.
